text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black receives a shocking 
confession from Satono Diamond.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Since there are still no signs of her 
growth spurt, she says she has no choice 
but to give up on debuting alongside 
Kitasan Black.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A crossroads had arrived for the two who 
had always been together. The childhood 
promise to "run the Classic Triple Crown 
together" would also go unfulfilled.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, Kitasan Black resolved to give it 
her all as a dependable older sister 
figure to Satono Diamond, who would be 
debuting the following year.
